jobs.description:

Your tasks:

 
• Picking orders with a hand scanner
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Working with an electric pallet truck (BT)
 
• Moving trailers safely around the site with a Terberg vehicle
 
• Checking goods in the warehouse management system (WMS)
 
• Keeping your workplace clean and safe

Some days you may spend more time in the warehouse, while at other times you will mainly move trailers on site.

 
• Experience in warehouse operations
 
• Comfortable working with scanners and digital systems
 
• Experience driving a Terberg / terminal tractor or similar vehicle
 
• Experience with an electric pallet truck
 
• Good knowledge of English or Dutch
 
• Team player with a safety-first mindset
 
• Valid CE driving licence or Terminal Tractor (Terberg) certificate

Your Job as a Cross Contamination Compliance Engineer

Do you enjoy combining quality compliance with technical risk management in a pharmaceutical production environment? As a Cross Contamination Compliance Engineer, you will play a key role in maintaining and strengthening the cross contamination strategy at a leading API manufacturing site in Geel. You will work closely with operations and multiple departments to identify, assess, and mitigate contamination risks. Your expertise will help ensure sustainable compliance and support safe manufacturing processes. This is a visible role with a direct impact on quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Fortunately, we can count on you for:

 
• Maintaining and reviewing cross contamination risk assessments
 
• Ensuring contamination risks remain controlled during MoC activities
 
• Preparing, facilitating, and documenting cross contamination FMEAs
 
• Supporting operations during complex quality incidents and investigations
 
• Identifying improvement opportunities within contamination control processes
 
• Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across manufacturing and quality
 
• Contributing to the site's contamination control strategy and compliance goals

You communicate clearly with different stakeholders and know how to build strong working relationships. You approach challenges in a structured way and can balance quality requirements with operational realities. You enjoy coordinating activities and bringing people together around a common objective.

What do you bring?

 
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Technology, Chemistry, Bioengineering or equivalent experience
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a pharmaceutical or industrial manufacturing environment
 
• Knowledge of GMP, change management, FMEA, and risk assessment methodologies
 
• Understanding of cross contamination risks and contamination control principles; Annex 1 knowledge is an asset
 
• Fluent in English; Dutch is considered a strong asset

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated individual to join our accounting team. As an 
Accounts Payable Specialist, you will play a crucial role in the creation and execution of our Accounts Payable 2.0 processes, transitioning from manual invoice processing to automated workflows, with a focus on KPI reporting, efficiency enhancement, and transparency. The ideal candidate will have excellent analytical skills, advanced proficiency in Excel and SAP.
 

This role will address existing challenges, establish robust processes, and ensure the accurate and timely processing of all AP flows.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Test and implement new or updated vendor invoice management systems. 

• Develop and implement effective processes and KPIs to streamline and monitor manual tasks. 

• Implement critical checkpoints for automatically posted invoices to ensure accuracy and efficiency. 

• Collaborate with Logistics and Purchasing teams to identify opportunities for improvement and increase the number of automatically processed invoices.

• Provide guidance and training to the accounting team to bridge knowledge gaps and improve overall team efficiency. 

• Foster transparency in operational processes, vendor balances, and dispute resolutions.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and intermediate SAP knowledge. 

• Strong communication skills in English. 

• Analytical skills to design and implement checks for automation in the P2P process. 

• Ability to lead and collaborate with cross-functional and international teams. 

• Detail-oriented, with strong organizational and time management skills. 

• Ability to adapt to a dynamic work environment and drive positive change.

To support the ambitious course in Belgium and Luxembourg, Wanzl is looking for an entrepreunerial Business Development Manager.  This role is pivotal in driving the new era, turning premium product innovations and digital solutions into sustainable market share.

You combine traditional sales with high-level strategic business development to gain market share with new, digital, and automated solutions. You pioneer new growth areas while further expanding existing strategic partnerships.
 
 

• You further design and implement a sustainable go-to-market strategy to successfully position the renewed Wanzl portfolio in the market. 

• You take responsibility for major, existing key accounts in retail and proactively expand the C-level relationship network within complex Decision Making Units. 

• You actively identify market opportunities for product innovations (such as digital retail and automation solutions) and lead the acquisition process from A to Z, including complex price negotiations. 

• You implement structured and data-driven sales management (CRM, forecasting, and account planning) to achieve commercial performance and strict P&L and margin targets. 

• You work closely with the local sales and operational teams and the international headquarters to guarantee an optimal customer journey and efficient collaboration. 
 

• You hold a university degree and have 10 to 15 years of proven successful B2B sales and business development experience, preferably in retail or other relevant sector.

jobs.occupation: Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering Data Centres
jobs.description:
As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you coordinate the entire engineering and design process. You monitor the technical scope, planning and engineering budget, ensuring that the different disciplines work together towards one integrated design.

• Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams within complex data centre projects

• Manage the technical scope, engineering budget and associated contract documentation

• Prepare and monitor the engineering schedule and allocate tasks within the team

• Coordinate the different technical disciplines and ensure alignment between their designs

• Coordinate collaboration between Belgian and international engineering teams

• Work closely with external consultants, contractors and other technical partners

• Review technical design decisions and challenge or adjust them where necessary

• Manage design changes and assess their impact on the overall project

• Translate complex client requirements into technically feasible solutions

• Present and discuss technical concepts with clients and project teams

• Remain involved during the execution phase and act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders

For the position of Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, we are looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent coordination skills. Experience within data centres is an advantage, but experience with industrial buildings or other technically complex building projects can also be a strong match.

• You hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline

• You have at least 5 years of experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects

• You have experience leading and coordinating engineers and other technical stakeholders

• You are familiar with complex technical building installations and multidisciplinary engineering

• Experience with data centres, industrial buildings or other complex built environments is a strong advantage

• You are familiar with digital engineering processes, 3D design and BIM environments

• You have a good understanding of relevant standards, regulations and working methods within engineering and construction

• You communicate effectively with engineers, consultants, contractors and clients

• English knowledge is a must, Dutch and French are a plus

Relevant experience is essential for this position. We are specifically looking for candidates who have previously worked in a similar role, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects within data centres, industrial buildings or other technically complex environments.

If you do not have relevant experience in a comparable position or project environment, we kindly ask you not to apply for this vacancy.

As an Import & Export Coordinator at Lotus Bakeries, you play a key role in ensuring the seamless flow of goods across international markets. You coordinate import and export shipments, manage customs processes, and work closely with logistics partners, internal stakeholders, and customs authorities.
 

As part of the Import & Export team you will:
 
 

• Coordinate and manage international import and export shipments across multiple transport modes (ocean, road, air, and multimodal), ensuring timely delivery while optimizing logistics flows to balance service, cost, and operational requirements. 

• Prepare and submit import and export customs declarations in-house or in collaboration with customs brokers, ensuring accuracy and compliance with applicable regulations. Manage communication with local customs authorities and internal compliance teams to facilitate efficient customs clearance and the timely resolution of customs-related issues. 

• Monitor transport performance and proactively resolve issues such as delays, demurrage, detention, and other operational disruptions. 

• Maintain accurate shipping and customs documentation and follow up on discrepancies or corrective actions when needed. 

• Ensure accurate data entry and management across logistics and customs systems, including master data maintenance and customs decision tables in CAS, while safeguarding data quality, integrity, and compliance. 

• Act as the key operational contact for shipment-related questions and escalations and support the implementation of new logistics and customs processes. 
 

• You have a Bachelor or Master degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Transport, Customs, or a related field. 

• A (first) experience with international freight flows and customs formalities has given you a good understanding of ocean, road, and air transport. 

• With your strong organizational and communication skills in both Dutch & English, you are able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining an accurate and detail-oriented approach. 

• Working independently comes naturally to you, while you also enjoy collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to achieve shared goals. 

• A proactive, hands-on, and customer-focused mindset helps you adapt to changing priorities and remain effective under pressure. 

• You are comfortable working with Microsoft Office, and experience with SAP S/4 or customs systems is considered a plus. 

• Your genuine interest in international supply chain, trade, and customs motivates you to continuously learn and develop in this field.

LVO Industries is a permanent capital holding company. We acquire family-owned and owner-operated businesses and partner with them to ensure their long-term success. At LVO, you’ll join a small, dynamic team operating in an entrepreneurial environment.
 

Role & Responsibilities :As CTO, you are the digital control tower of the LVO group, responsible for the digital aspects of every portfolio company: Odoo, AI, software development and the Microsoft stack. You bring strong engineering and real AI expertise, set the standards, and make sure the right technology choices and practices are followed everywhere. The job is as much about coaching the teams as building IT solutions yourself in Odoo, AI and beyond. Your responsibilities will evolve over time, and will at least include:
 
 

• make sure all digital tools (Odoo, AI agents, the Microsoft stack, other third-party software) are well chosen and used to their full potential across teams. 

• ensure the IT teams are highly efficient and well-functioning, coaching them on engineering and AI best practices, code quality and testing. 

• drive the development of AI agents to accelerate automation, improve customer satisfaction and replace costly tools, building them yourself and enabling the POs and IT teams to build and run them. 

• implement, follow up and continuously optimize Odoo across the portfolio companies. 

• oversee the broader technical foundation: hosting, architecture, cybersecurity, testing and data. 

• help select external providers and partners, and make sure they deliver.  

Success means a digital strategy that performs across the group: strong automation, a better experience for staff and customers, solid cybersecurity, and technology that is future-proof and cost-effective.

Mindset :More than anything else, we are looking for a candidate with a positive attitude, who is:
 
 

• a builder who codes and configures as naturally as they advise 

• a teacher at heart who leaves teams stronger than they found them 

• obsessed with using AI and automation to remove friction 

• comfortable carrying influence without a title to back it up 

• self-starting, pragmatic, allergic to needless process 

• at ease jumping between companies, stacks and roles 

• dependable: says what they'll do, then does it  

Requirements :
 
 

• a genuine developer and IT engineer background (degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent): you have built and shipped software yourself, stay hands-on with code, and are comfortable across the stack from application architecture to hosting, cybersecurity and automated testing 

• between 5 and 10 years implementing IT and automation projects, including ERP set-ups, in small and medium-sized businesses. 

• real depth in AI: hands-on experience designing and deploying AI-based solutions, and a clear view on applying AI best practices in a business context 

• able to be based in Brussels (Watermael-Boitsfort) and to travel within Belgium. 

• strong written and verbal communication skills in Dutch, French and English

The R&I Policy Officer will support CLERENS in their work for the Batteries European Partnership Association (BEPA). BEPA represents the battery innovation community in Brussels, representing both industry and research members. BEPA is the private partner in the Horizon Europe Batt4EU Partnership with the European Commission.

In close cooperation with the Secretary General and other BEPA team members, the consultant will help BEPA transition from the current Horizon Europe framework to the new R&I ecosystem that will come with the new EU budget. The R&I Policy Officer will bring strong technical expertise in batteries to support multiple BEPA Technical Working Groups and/or Task Forces. These working groups range in size from 50 to almost 200 battery experts and prepare the official inputs given by BEPA to the European Commission on the strategic direction of battery research within the Horizon Europe Programme and beyond.

Main Duties:

¿            You lead the operational management of BEPA Working Groups and Task Forces, working alongside chairs and co-chairs to ensure outputs are delivered on time. You own the agenda, drive discussions, present updates, and coordinate the dissemination of information.

¿            Support, together with the Secretary General and Executive Director, the monthly meetings of the Executive Board meetings, by preparing and following up on the strategic decisions taken;

¿            Contribute, in terms of content and organisation, to BEPA events, like the General Assembly and the Battery Innovation Days, and smaller events like technical workshops and matchmaking events;

¿            Actively engage with the BEPA members. Follow up on enquiries by current members, engage with prospective members by conducting proactive outreach activities and welcoming new members into the organisation;

¿            Support the BEPA Communication Officer by providing content for BEPA publications (e.g. newsletter, website, social media, etc.);
 
¿            University or advanced degree (doctorat) in battery or electrochemical engineering, electrochemistry, (battery) materials science, or a closely related technical field.

¿            In-depth technical knowledge of the battery sector: battery science, cell chemistry, materials, manufacturing, and system integration, combined with a solid understanding of the industry landscape, markets, value chains, and key players.

¿            Between 3-5 years of relevant experience in battery or energy-related R&I, whether in industry, a research institution, or a European association; experience with EU-funded innovation projects is an asset.

¿            Good knowledge of the workings of the European Union, in particular in the sphere of research and innovation (Horizon Europe); previous experience engaging with EU institutions or R&I policy is an asset.

¿            Ability to quickly grasp new topics and process information effectively, and to put thoughts into actions quickly.

¿            Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with attention to detail.

¿            Capacity to collect, organise and analyse quantitative and qualitative data.

¿            Ability to plan and work independently, manage stress, multiple deadlines and effectively prioritise workload.

¿            Fluency in English is necessary; any additional European language is an asset.

¿            Proficiency in MS Office applications is a must; acquaintance with other software is a strong advantage.
 
¿            The opportunity to work for a great European initiative concretely supporting the clean energy transition.

¿            A challenging, multi-faceted role in a dynamic team with room to grow and take on additional responsibilities.

¿            A stimulating and dynamic international environment.

 

Applications

To apply, please send a motivation letter and CV in English to the HR Manager, Eftychia Michailidou at hr@clerens.eu with ¿BEPA - R&I Policy Officer¿ in the subject line.

 

Be aware that applications are reviewed continuously upon arrival; therefore, applying as soon as possible is advisable. Due to the expected high number of applications, only short-listed candidates will be contacted for interviews.
